description: At stopped joints, read both actual gripper positions: fully open is empty; intermediate is holding; only fully closed hands require Decisions using current contact-area RGB and same-capture feedback. No SAM3 or historical holding images are needed. Commands are not position evidence. Confirmed empty hands permit clearing provisional holding and observing geometry for return. Carrying return uses the already verified identity and attachment. Preserve the original failure and stop after return.
